name: Hamelin
source: While [url=/c91604]Rapunzel[/url] is just an airhead, Hamelin is a true idiot. She is a delinquent who always hangs out at a vacant classroom, and it's not known whether she goes to classes or which year student she is. Due to her troublemaking nature Hamelin is often witnessed being chased by [url=/c91736]Akazukin[/url], and even known for being number two in school equipment damaging. She sometimes tries using lots of difficult and pretentious words while talking, but always screws up or bites her tongue.
